evals.prompt: Integrate slug, Jalali date, and money factories into a Payload collection and verify package Admin component resolution.
evals.expected_output: Options-object factory usage with correct tuple spread, single fields, server/client boundaries, Import Map validation, and package tests.
expectations: Spreads slugField and inserts date/money fields directly.
Preserves package-owned component paths and server-safe root imports.
Builds/tests the package and verifies the consuming Import Map.

evals.prompt: Add consumer hooks and admin metadata to all factories without replacing package normalization, validation, timestamp formatting, or Import Map components.
evals.expected_output: A source-grounded override design with explicit hook ordering and protected fields.
expectations: Inspects actual spread and hook order in each factory.
Keeps package hooks and required Admin components authoritative.

evals.prompt: Review a Payload config that passes an AI generator callback and API key into slug Admin clientProps and overrides semantic field types.
evals.expected_output: A security and contract review that keeps callbacks/secrets server-side and rejects protected overrides.
expectations: Moves generator implementation and secrets into payloadFieldsPlugin.
Sends only a registered generator key to the client.

evals.prompt: Diagnose why Payload cannot resolve an Admin field component after changing its subpath even though the source component compiles.
evals.expected_output: An end-to-end trace through factory path, package export, bundler entrypoint, and generated Import Map.
expectations: Checks the exact component path and named export.
Checks package.json exports and esbuild entrypoints.
Regenerates and validates the consuming Import Map/Admin build.

evals.prompt: Change only the rule for regenerating a locked localized slug when its nested source is cleared.
evals.expected_output: A handoff to payload-fields-slug while preserving core protected factory constraints.
expectations: Recognizes slug synchronization as the primary specialized skill.
Composes with payload-fields-slug rather than broad package rewrite.
